hero.title: Software that organizes your operations and makes every step visible
hero.subtitle: We build custom software to automate tasks, track each process and bring your data together. Less scattered information. More clarity for your team.

solutions.title: Software that helps your business work better
solutions.description: We start with how your operations work and build tools to support them.

customSoftware.title: Custom software
customSoftware.description: We build internal systems and customer platforms tailored to the way you work.

automation.title: Process automation
automation.description: We connect tasks and systems to reduce manual work and avoid copying and pasting.

traceability.title: Tracking and traceability
traceability.description: See the status, owners and pending tasks of each process in one place.

dataIntegration.title: Data and integrations
dataIntegration.description: We connect data from spreadsheets and tools to give your team a shared view of operations.

customSoftware.before: A request is waiting for an owner.
customSoftware.after: The request has a team assigned.

automation.before: The order requires manually creating a task.
automation.after: The order creates the task in the system.

traceability.before: The request has been received and awaits assignment.
traceability.after: The team can see both the status and the owner.

dataIntegration.before: Information is checked in separate sources.
dataIntegration.after: The sources come together in a shared view.

workflow.title: The same operation, two ways to work
workflow.description: Compare a manual workflow with a software solution. These examples show capabilities, not measured outcomes.

manual.summary: Requests waiting for review and assignment.
manual.point0: The request is split between a spreadsheet and messages.
manual.point1: Assignment depends on a manual review.

optimized.summary: The request has an owner and status in the same system.
optimized.point0: Requests centralized in a custom interface.
optimized.point1: Owner and status visible in the same system.

manual.summary: Orders accumulate while tasks are reviewed and created.
manual.point0: Each order requires copying data and creating a task.
manual.point1: The queue moves when someone reviews the orders.

optimized.summary: The order connects with rules and task assignment.
optimized.point0: Rules connect the order with task creation.
optimized.point1: Assignment is part of the workflow.

manual.summary: Changes await review before the status is updated.
manual.point0: Status and owner are checked in different sources.
manual.point1: Scattered changes make the history harder to reconstruct.

optimized.summary: Status, owner and history together in one record.
optimized.point0: Each process brings together status, owner and history.
optimized.point1: Changes are available in a shared record.

manual.summary: Data awaits reconciliation to bring the sources together.
manual.point0: Each source is checked and copied separately.
manual.point1: A combined view requires manual reconciliation.

optimized.summary: Sources connect to a shared view.
optimized.point0: Sources connected to a shared view.
optimized.point1: Information is available from the central system.

about.title: We work closely with your team
about.description: We are two partners who build solutions with the people who use them. First, we understand your operations; then we decide what to organize, connect or automate.
about.aiNote: We use artificial intelligence when it adds value to the solution.

first.name: Thomas Curvelo Ferrer
first.biography: Full stack developer with over three years of experience. Trained at Universidad Austral, he builds web applications with Angular and .NET.

second.name: Juan Lucas Cuenca
second.biography: Backend developer at Valkimia with a programming degree from Universidad Austral. He builds services, automations and AI agents with Python.

timeline.title: How we work
timeline.description: From understanding your operations to building a tool you can use every day.

step1.title: Understand
step1.description: We talk with your team to understand your operations, manual tasks and where visibility is lost.

step2.title: Define
step2.description: Together, we decide what to organize, connect or automate and agree on the scope of the solution.

step3.title: Build
step3.description: We develop the software and validate it with the people who will use it, adapting it to their work.

step4.title: Support
step4.description: We launch the solution and support your team as they use and evolve it.

cta.title: Tell us which process you want to improve
cta.description: We can help turn scattered tasks into tools that support your operations.
